نرتزق (form VIII)
# نَرْتَزِقُ (nartaziqu) /nar.ta.zi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَزَقَ (irtazaqa)
# نَرْتَزِقَ (nartaziqa) /nar.ta.zi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَزَقَ (irtazaqa)
# نَرْتَزِقْ (nartaziq) /nar.ta.ziq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَزَقَ (irtazaqa)
